_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. Pinned to commit SHAs, not a branch name, as of 0.1.9 -- a branch pin silently picks up whatever that branch's HEAD is at tag-push time, which twice produced a release missing work that had already been committed to the branch but not accounted for when the tag was cut. A SHA pin makes exactly what's bundled explicit and reviewable in this file's own diff. pine-lang unchanged (still master's 0.38.1). beamlynx-ui bumped to its tagged 0.48.2 -- a pure re-pin, no functional change from 0.48.1: 0.48.1's own changelog cleanup (dropping an internal-only build-tooling entry) landed on beamlynx-ui's main *after* the 0.48.1 tag was already cut, so the actually-tagged/bundled 0.48.1 artifact never got it. 0.48.2 just gives this a clean tag to pin to that includes it.
